stories.delivered_paragraph: The Federal Communications Commission will bar imports of foreign-made advanced robotic devices and power inverters, including mobile humanoid and quadruped robots, citing what it calls unacceptable risks. stories.delivered_paragraph: The Federal Aviation Administration is moving to waive some environmental requirements for space-launch approvals, a change that could speed licensing for companies including SpaceX and Blue Origin.
